class.name: OcgGeom2dDirection
class.brief_description: The class Direction specifies a vector that is never null. It is a unit vector.
class.description: ! The class Direction specifies a vector that is never null. ! It is a unit vector.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a unit vector with it 2 cartesian coordinates.

method.name: SetCoord
method.description: Assigns the coordinates X and Y to this unit vector, then normalizes it. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if Sqrt(X*X + Y*Y) is less than or equal to gp::Resolution().

method.name: SetDir2d
method.description: Converts the gp_Dir2d unit vector V into this unit vector.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Assigns a value to the X coordinate of this unit vector, then normalizes it. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if the value assigned causes the magnitude of the vector to become less than or equal to gp::Resolution().

method.name: SetY
method.description: Assigns a value to the Y coordinate of this unit vector, then normalizes it. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if the value assigned causes the magnitude of the vector to become less than or equal to gp::Resolution().

method.name: Dir2d
method.description: Converts this unit vector into a gp_Dir2d unit vector.

method.name: Crossed
method.description: Computes the cross product between <me> and <Other>.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this unit vector, then normalizes it.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this unit vector.
